events.verdict: Hardy (DAL) moves forward and initiates body to body contact with Mitchell (OKC) that affects his SQBR. This is the first illegal contact on the play and occurs prior to Mitchell responding by wrapping his arm around Hardy.
Washington (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) during the pass attempt.
Dort (OKC) initiates illegal contact with Davis' (DAL) arm and shoulder, which affects his play at the basket.
Hartenstein (OKC) is already in Washington's (DAL) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Davis (DAL) legally contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) grazes Russell's (DAL) hair as he contests the driving shot attempt.
Davis (DAL) legally contests Hartenstein's (OKC) driving shot attempt.
Davis (DAL) is already in Wallace's (OKC) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Wallace (OKC) contests Russell's (DAL) jump shot attempt and the contact with Russell's non-shooting hand after the release is marginal.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Washington (DAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Washington cleanly dislodges the ball from Holmgren (OKC) and the ball ricochets off Washington's foot last before going out of bounds. Possession was correctly awarded to the Thunder.
Marshall (DAL) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is moving alongside Washington's (DAL) path and the body contact as they come together is marginal.
Davis (DAL) initiates contact with Holmgren's (OKC) arm and the contact affects his ability to control the ball.
Holmgren (OKC) legally contests and cleanly blocks Flagg's (DAL) shot attempt.
